neighbours.label: the word 'Corps' (Army Corps of Engineers, Marine Corps, AmeriCorps)
fire: The levee was rebuilt by the Army Corps of Engineers after the flood.
Her grandfather served in the Marine Corps during the Korean War.
After college he spent a year with AmeriCorps teaching reading in Ohio.
The Peace Corps sent volunteers to build wells in the northern villages.
The general moved his whole corps across the river before dawn.
She joined the press corps that follows the president on foreign trips.
The cadets marched past the stands with the drum corps in front.
A report by the Corps of Engineers warned about the old dam.
quiet: The levee was rebuilt by the state highway department after the flood.
Her grandfather served in the Navy during the Korean War.
After college he spent a year with a charity teaching reading in Ohio.
The church sent volunteers to build wells in the northern villages.
The general moved his whole army across the river before dawn.
She joined the group of reporters that follows the president on foreign trips.
The cadets marched past the stands with the brass band in front.
A report by the water authority warned about the old dam.
